ModMetaData.name: Filter by Example
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Allow or disallow exactly the items you picked, without hunting through a filter tree.
- Select real items, choose Allow or Disallow by example, then click a stockpile or shelf - Only those exact item definitions change - No category-wide, quality, hit-point, or priority changes - Works with linked shelves and modded items - Defaults to Q and E; both keys are rebindable
Requires Harmony and SpineLib.
